content.text: Today's AI agent landscape is shifting rapidly from experimentation to real-world deployment. Open-source agent frameworks have hit a major production milestone as adoption triples, while startups increasingly rely on model-driven agents to replace hand-coded orchestration. The industry's focus is turning toward tool-calling reliability as the key benchmark for frontier models, and multi-agent swarms are graduating from flashy demos to regulated enterprise workflows. Meanwhile, observability standards are emerging to help organizations trace agent decisions end to end—a critical step as autonomous systems take on higher-stakes tasks.
